id: 34_Importance of Fire Safety in Microbiology Labs, fire safety, trending fire safet
title: 微生物实验室的消防安全
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/34_Importance of Fire Safety in Microbiology Labs, fire safety, trending fire safet.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/34_Importance of Fire Safety in Microbiology Labs, fire safety, trending fire safet/src.py

points.K2: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
points.K3: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
points.K7: 第四，依法落实消防责任

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，旁边墙上挂着灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab door next to a wall-mounted fire extinguisher and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天说说微生物实验室的消防安全。
overlay: 微生物实验室的消防安全

shots.scene: 灭火器、火焰、安全出口三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a fire extinguisher, a small flame, and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 防火、报警、逃生，一个都不能少。

shots.scene: 阿杰在实验台上点着酒精灯，旁边放着一瓶乙醇
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lights a spirit lamp on a lab bench; a blank-labeled bottle of ethanol stands right next to it.
shots.narration: 阿杰点上酒精灯，乙醇瓶就在手边。

shots.scene: 小研快步走来，把乙醇瓶挪远
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over quickly and moves the ethanol bottle far away from the flame.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧把瓶子挪开。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，小研指着墙上的灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head; the female graduate student points at the fire extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：微生物实验室也怕火吗？

shots.scene: 盾牌图标下面三个小图标：禁止、眼睛、灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon above three small icons: a prohibition sign, an eye, and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 消防安全，就是一整套措施：

shots.scene: 实验室天花板上的烟感探测器
shots.prompt_en: A smoke detector on a lab ceiling with a small green light. No people.
shots.narration: 预防火灾，及早发现，

shots.scene: 小研从墙上取下灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a fire extinguisher down from its wall bracket.
shots.narration: 起火时能正确应对。

shots.scene: 人员、仪器、培养箱三个图标被盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A person icon, an instrument icon and an incubator icon all covered by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 护住人，护住设备，也护住科研。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
shots.scene: 易燃液体瓶、纸箱、加热板三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a bottle with a flammable warning sign, a stack of cardboard boxes, and a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室里，火灾隐患不少。
overlay: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患

shots.section_title: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
shots.scene: 乙醇、消毒剂瓶贴着易燃标志
shots.prompt_en: Bottles of ethanol and alcohol-based disinfectant, each with a flammable warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 乙醇、含醇消毒剂都是易燃品，

shots.section_title: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
shots.scene: 纸巾、包装盒、塑料培养皿堆在一起
shots.prompt_en: Paper towels, packaging boxes and plastic dishes piled together on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 纸张、包装、塑料耗材都能烧，

shots.section_title: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
shots.scene: 酒精灯、电热灭菌器、恒温箱
shots.prompt_en: A spirit lamp, a small electric loop sterilizer and an incubator side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 还有酒精灯和各种电热设备。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的三类火灾隐患
shots.scene: 三个图标中间冒出火苗，旁边红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A small flame appears where the three hazard icons meet, with a red exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 管不好，三样凑在一起就会着火。

shots.section_title: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
shots.scene: 几种外形不同的灭火器并排，标签空白
shots.prompt_en: Several fire extinguishers of different shapes stand side by side, their labels blank. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器不是随便拿一个就行。
overlay: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号

shots.section_title: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
shots.scene: 木头、液体、气瓶、金属、插头、炒锅六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in a row: burning wood, a burning liquid, a gas cylinder, a metal block, an electric plug, and a frying pan. No people.
shots.narration: 国内把火灾分成六类。

shots.section_title: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
shots.scene: 小研凑近看灭火器上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leans in to read the blank label on a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 先看清灭火器适用哪类火。

shots.section_title: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
shots.scene: 水桶泼向冒火插座的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being thrown onto a burning electrical socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电器着火，先断电，不能用水泼。

shots.section_title: 火灾分种类，灭火器要对号
shots.scene: 燃烧的金属块旁一个问号和专用标志
shots.prompt_en: A burning metal block icon next to a question mark and a special-purpose extinguisher icon. No people.
shots.narration: 金属着火要用专用灭火剂。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字一的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number one.
shots.narration: 消防为什么重要？第一，保护人员。

shots.scene: 墙上灭火器和一张空白疏散图
shots.prompt_en: A wall-mounted fire extinguisher next to a blank evacuation floor plan with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器和疏散预案，都是为了人。

shots.scene: 烧伤和烟雾的图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a burn and of rising smoke, both blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 避免烧伤，也避免吸入烟气。

shots.scene: 浓烟中的人形图标捂住口鼻、弯腰前进
shots.prompt_en: A person icon covering nose and mouth, bending low and moving under a layer of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 烟气往往比火更致命。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字二的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number two.
shots.narration: 第二，保全科研成果。

shots.scene: 冰箱里的样品盒、硬盘和记录本
shots.prompt_en: Sample boxes in a refrigerator, a hard drive and a blank notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 数据、样本和仪器，都是多年心血，

shots.scene: 小研把数据备份到另一个硬盘
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student copies files from a laptop with a blank screen to a second hard drive.
shots.narration: 一场火就可能全部毁掉。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字三的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number three.
shots.narration: 第三，减少财产损失。

shots.scene: 实验楼、生物安全柜、离心机图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab building, a biological safety cabinet and a centrifuge. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室房屋、设备都很贵重，

shots.scene: 被熏黑的实验台面图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lab bench blackened by smoke, with a broken instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 做好消防，才能少受损失。

shots.section_title: 第四，依法落实消防责任
shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字四的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number four.
shots.narration: 第四，依法落实消防责任。
overlay: 第四，依法落实消防责任

shots.section_title: 第四，依法落实消防责任
shots.scene: 一本空白法规书和学校印章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank law book next to a school seal icon and a blank checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 消防法和学校制度都有明确要求。

shots.section_title: 第四，依法落实消防责任
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表检查灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator inspects a fire extinguisher while holding a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 单位和个人都有消防责任。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字五的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number five.
shots.narration: 第五，尽快恢复工作。

shots.scene: 日历和停工的仪器图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to an instrument with a pause symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有规划、有器材，火灾损失小，

shots.scene: 老李在维修后重新打开实验室灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the lab lights back on after repairs.
shots.narration: 实验室就能更快恢复工作。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起数字六的牌子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with a large number six.
shots.narration: 第六，保护环境。

shots.scene: 化学品瓶在火中破裂，烟雾飘向河流
shots.prompt_en: An icon of chemical bottles cracking in a fire, smoke drifting toward a river and trees. No people.
shots.narration: 火会让化学品和危险物质散出去，

shots.scene: 河流和树木图标被盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A river and trees icon protected by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 防住火，也就护住了环境。

shots.scene: 九宫格：电话、报警器、灭火器、消防员、着火房屋、出口等
shots.prompt_en: A three-by-three grid of icons: a phone, a fire alarm, a fire extinguisher, a firefighter, a burning house, a running person, a fire truck and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 消防，是一环扣一环的。

shots.scene: 报警按钮和手机图标
shots.prompt_en: A manual fire alarm button and a mobile phone icon with a blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 要会报警，

shots.scene: 灭火器和消防员图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher icon next to a firefighter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 要有灭火器材和专业救援，

shots.scene: 人形图标沿安全出口箭头跑出
shots.prompt_en: A running person icon follows emergency exit sign arrows out of a building. No people.
shots.narration: 还要能沿着出口安全撤离。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁出现三个图标：易燃瓶、报警按钮、出口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a flammable bottle, a fire alarm button and an emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 消防安全，防在前面。

shots.scene: 易燃品柜、远离热源的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flammable storage cabinet and a bottle kept away from a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃品少放，远离热源。

shots.scene: 报警按钮和手机图标
shots.prompt_en: A fire alarm button and a mobile phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 着火先报警，拨打119。

shots.scene: 小火灭火器、大火出口箭头
shots.prompt_en: A small flame with a fire extinguisher, and a big flame with an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 小火会扑，大火快撤。

shots.scene: 六个盾牌图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Six small shield icons in a row: a person, a notebook, a building, a law book, a calendar and a tree. No people.
shots.narration: 护人、护科研、护财产，也护环境。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在安全出口指示牌下挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye under a lit emergency exit sign.
shots.narration: 认清出口再开工，下次见！
